paths.description: Homepage and primary media-listing template; representative of public discovery and navigation.
Weekly ranking/listing archetype; sampled to compare a second content-list template.
Short-form video journey and UK age-verification gate.
Account creation and consent/legal disclosure flow.

Not covered: authenticated history/watch-later, biometric verification completion, payment/subscription, individual explicit media playback, destructive account creation, and creator upload because they require credentials, identity, payment, or consequential user action.

findings.summary: Motion continues when reduced motion is requested
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched prefers-reduced-motion: reduce but still found eight running 2-second shimmer animations; static CSS inspection found no reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule that removes non-essential shimmer/transition animation.

findings.summary: Important text and controls fail contrast requirements
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured age-verification text at 2.15:1 and 1.75:1, metadata at 3.29:1, and an inline link at only 1.28:1 against surrounding text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use tokens whose computed foreground/background contrast meets WCAG AA and underline inline links.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use deliberate view transitions
findings.evidence: Rendered/source probes found no view-transition CSS or transition declarations on four representative templates, despite a navigation-heavy MPA.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document view transitions for compatible page navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The long listing has no scroll-position guidance
findings.evidence: The home template is a long listing, but source inspection found no scroll-state query, scroll timeline, progress affordance, or other scroll-aware chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight progress/affordance treatment for long result lists.

findings.summary: The signup modal is an ad-hoc dialog container
findings.evidence: The signup probe found a div with role=dialog and aria-modal=true rather than a native dialog; no dialog, popover, or details primitives were present in captured templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for the modal flow and its built-in focus, escape, and close behavior.

findings.summary: Reusable cards only adapt at viewport level
findings.evidence: Across home, ranking, shorts, and signup templates, static CSS evidence found no container-type or @container rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list components containment and container-query breakpoints where their parent width varies.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch-target affordances are insufficient
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus showed no visible outline or shadow on the search input/button, and Lighthouse found an obscured/overlapping interactive target with 0px safe spacing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and ensure every target has at least 24px safe size/spacing, preferably 44px for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: Intermittent failures end in a bare server error with no recovery
findings.evidence: Repeated direct navigations during screenshot and signup interaction attempts returned a plain 503 nginx page with no retry, back, or status guidance, while other attempts succeeded.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded, accessible 503 state with retry/back controls and preserve the user journey across transient failures.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 3.1s and FCP at 2.4s; the root response alone took 846ms. A desktop trace was faster at 1.11s LCP, showing condition-sensitive performance.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document latency and critical-path work, then validate mobile LCP at or below 2.5s.

findings.summary: Critical delivery includes long render-blocking and weakly cached work
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1,180ms savings from render-blocking CSS and 114KiB from longer cache lifetimes; HAR recorded 142 requests and 1.73MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline/minimise critical CSS, defer non-critical styles/scripts, and lengthen immutable asset cache lifetimes.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable script and style work
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 26KiB unused JavaScript and 56KiB unused CSS; HAR recorded 62 script requests and about 997KB of script transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template and remove or defer unused and third-party bundles until user intent.

findings.summary: Controls and content structures have accessibility-tree defects
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an unnamed button, thumbnail names that omit visible duration text, and a list with invalid direct children.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a matching accessible name and restore valid list semantics without nested conflicting roles.

findings.summary: Focus and semantic structure are unreliable
findings.evidence: The focus probe found no visible focus treatment on key search controls, and Lighthouse found invalid list structure and an inappropriate button role on a list item.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native interactive elements, valid list children, logical focus order, and visible :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is explicitly disabled and a target is obstructed
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no in the effective mobile viewport meta and a target with no safe clickable spacing.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale restrictions; fix overlap and target spacing at narrow/zoomed layouts.

findings.summary: Many images lack intrinsic dimensions or are oversized
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 29 of 36 images without both dimensions and 12 rendered at less than half their natural width; Lighthouse corroborated unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and tighten srcset sizes to actual card widths.

findings.summary: The public rich-content listing lacks entity and share metadata
findings.evidence: The home probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph properties even though the page exposes a large media catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate WebSite/ItemList or VideoObject JSON-LD where appropriate and Open Graph preview metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Cookie and response defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers lacked X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy; CSP only declared frame-ancestors. Four of five cookies were flagged, including non-Secure settings, x_csrf_token, and g_state cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all cookies Secure with the narrowest SameSite/HttpOnly policy and deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP plus nosniff and Referrer-Policy.

findings.summary: The initial page has a broad third-party and analytics footprint
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 116 third-party requests and 1.54MB third-party transfer across 11 origins, including ad/recommendation endpoints carrying a persistent stats UID and browsing context.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential ads/analytics on consent and intent, minimise identifiers, batch events, and defer third parties.

findings.summary: Account entry offers federated and email sign-up but no phishing-resistant passkey path
findings.evidence: The signup route exposed Google, X, and email options; rendered/source probes found no enabled WebAuthn or passkey authentication path.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside account recovery and federated options.

findings.summary: Core interaction explicitly requires JavaScript
findings.evidence: The signup document noscript fallback says “JavaScript is required for this website” rather than preserving the account flow, despite substantial server-rendered content.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep core navigation and account form actions functional as HTML, layering enhanced dialogs and validation on top.

findings.summary: The many localized variants are not built on robust bidi/logical layout foundations
findings.evidence: The page links to roughly 40 locale hosts and sets lang=en, but omits dir and captured CSS uses almost no logical properties while relying on physical layout rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang and dir per locale and replace physical left/right sizing and spacing with logical properties.

findings.summary: Media assets are not consistently right-sized
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 12 oversized images, 16 legacy-format URLs, 3 images without srcset, and 8 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate tighter responsive variants, use modern formats consistently, and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: Initial loading performs disproportionate script and third-party work
findings.evidence: The home load made 142 requests, transferred 1.73MB, ran 62 script requests, and sent 116 requests to third-party origins before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer recommendations, ads, analytics, and non-visible modules until consent, visibility, or interaction.
